# Salwah Events and Catering (Salwah Events Ltd)

> Luxury 100% HMC Certified Halal Asian wedding catering (Bengali, Pakistani, and Indian), bespoke floral wedding stage decoration, and full event management across Greater London, Essex, and Kent.

## Key Verified Business Facts
- Business Name: Salwah Events and Catering (Salwah Events Ltd)
- Kitchen & Office Address: Unit 7 Landmark Commercial Centre, 7 Commercial Road, Edmonton, London, N18 1UB
- Phone / WhatsApp: 07359 337887 (+447359337887)
- Email: info@salwahevents.com
- Opening Hours: Mon–Sun: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Halal Standard: 100% HMC Certified Halal — Dedicated Halal Kitchen
- Starting Price: From £30 per person (Silver £30pp, Gold £45pp, Platinum All-Inclusive from £17,500 for 200 guests)
- Guest Capacity: 50–1,000+ guests (intimate Nikah & Mehndi to grand 1,000+ guest Walima banquets)
- Service Areas: Greater London (East, North, West & South London), Essex & Kent
- Rating: 5.0★ Google Rating

## Packages & Pricing Summary
- Silver Package (£30 per person): Ideal for elegant Nikah ceremonies, Mehndis, and intimate receptions. Includes: 2 Starters (Choice of Grills & Savouries); 3 Main Courses (Chicken, Lamb & Vegetarian); Fragrant Pilau Rice & Fresh Naan Bread; Crisp Salad & House Chutneys; 1 Traditional Dessert; Full Crockery & Cutlery; Uniformed Professional Waiting Staff.
- Gold Package (£45 per person): Our most popular choice for grand Asian wedding receptions & Walimas. Includes: 3 Starters (Including Chargrilled Kebabs & Tikka); 4 Main Courses (Premium Bengali, Pakistani & Indian Selection); Choice of Biryani, Pilau Rice & Fresh Breads; Full Salad Display, Raita & Chutneys; 2 Luxury Desserts (e.g., Gulab Jamun, Roshmalai or Milk Cake); Gourmet Welcome Mocktails & Soft Drinks; Full Fine Crockery, Cutlery & Glassware; Experienced Waiting Staff & On-Site Event Supervisor.
- Platinum Package (From £17,500 all-inclusive (200 guests)): The complete turn-key luxury wedding catering, stage decor & management experience. Includes: Full Gold Catering Menu for 200 Guests (Scalable up to 1,000+); Bespoke Luxury Wedding Stage Decoration & Floral Backdrop; Full Venue Ambient Lighting, Walkway & Setup; Table Centrepieces, Charger Plates & Luxury Linen; Interactive Dessert, Karak Chai or Paan Stall; Gourmet Welcome Mocktail Reception; Dedicated Lead Event Manager & On-the-Day Coordination.

## Signature 100% HMC Halal Menu Highlights
- Starters & Grills: Chicken Tikka, Chicken Malai Tikka, Chicken 65, Chicken Dynamix, Lamb Seekh Kebab, Peshawari Chapli Kebab, Vegetable Samosa, Papri Chaat, Chilli Paneer, Fish Masala, Spiced Chicken Drumsticks, Tandoori Chicken Wings
- Signature Main Courses: Lamb Bhuna, Beef Bhuna, Beef Rezala, Chittagong Beef Kala Bhuna, Traditional Bengali Chicken Roast, Chicken Karahi, Lamb Karahi Gosht, Chicken Tikka Jalfrezi, Chicken Curry (On the Bone), Chicken Butter Makhni, King Prawn Jalfrezi, Prawn Saag, Slow-Cooked Lamb Nihari, Mixed Vegetable with Prawn
- Rice, Pilau & Biryani: Dhakai Lamb Kacchi Biryani, Traditional Lamb Biryani, Lamb Pilau, Chicken Biryani, Chicken Pilau, Fragrant Basmati Pilau Rice, Steamed White Rice, Fresh Tandoori Naan & Garlic Naan
- Vegetable Dishes & Bengali Borthas: Mixed Seasonal Vegetables, Saag Aloo, Saag Paneer, Paneer Butter Makhni, Aloo Baingan, Bhindi Dupiaza, Vegetable Manchurian, Traditional Bengali Borthas (Aloo, Begun & Shutki on request)
- Daal Dishes: Tarka Daal, Chana Daal Masala, Daal Fry, Creamy Makhni Daal, Punjabi Chana Masala, Mung Daal Masala
- Desserts & Mithai: Roshmalai, Traditional Mishti Doi, Kalajam & Vanilla Ice Cream, Warm Gulab Jamun & Ice Cream, Gajar Halwa & Ice Cream, Pistachio Baklava & Ice Cream, Chilled Saffron Firni, Zarda Sweet Rice, Strawberry Cheesecake, Artisan Milk Cake
- Mocktails, Borhani & Chai: Traditional Bengali Spiced Borhani, Mango & Passionfruit Lassi, Fresh Mint & Lime Cooler Mocktail, Strawberry & Rose Fizz Mocktail, Lychee & Elderflower Cooler, Freshly Brewed Cardamom Karak Chai, Kashmiri Pink Chai Station, Artisan Filter Coffee & Herbal Teas
